思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S02 「快捷问题「当前用药」把暂停的药显示为暂停（医院；养老院变体）」 Preset 'current medications' shows a held drug as held (Hospital; NH variant)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each of the six quick-question presets (today's labs, current medications, pre-round note contents, urgent pending tasks, current diagnosis, symptoms mentioned) returns a correct, patient-specific an …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 4）
  • U5 The current-medications answer reflects the Medication Tracker; held drugs show as held.（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 7）
  • T4 TC-15 AI checks pass per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md. The substring checks in this matrix are a pre-screen, not that grading.（TFA-94229 AC 2；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Hospital patient whose tracker has 2 active rows and 1 held row; NH variant: resident with 1 active and 1 held row

When Ask preset "What medications is the patient on?"

Then Answer lists the active drugs and marks the held drug as held

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：All rows named and the held drug together with 'held' (U5). Which drug the word 'held' sits next to is read from the quoted answer; S07 asks it as an unambiguous question

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
